title: Contributing to Redis: Async cluster reliability in production
description: Lessons from diagnosing and resolving async event-loop connection lifecycle edge cases in Redis cluster pipelines.
heroAlt: Async Redis cluster pipeline connection lifecycle architecture.
html:
High-throughput cloud platforms rely on Redis for low-latency state, queuing, and real-time metering. When operating async Redis clusters under concurrent workloads, subtle event-loop lifecycle edge cases can surface during pipeline initialization and key-slot resolution.

Giving Back to Core Infrastructure

As an open-source contributor to redis-py, my focus has been ensuring that async cluster transactions isolate temporary resolution sockets cleanly and maintain rock-solid connection pool invariants across concurrent tasks.
